tools.name: get_orm_overview_report

tools.description: ORM's health board for a date range: how much the AI handled alone, handoffs to people, deals and tickets created and the reviews pulse. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_ai_performance_report
tools.title: Show the AI performance report
tools.description: How the AI assistant carried the social inbox for a date range: auto-send rate, confidence, handoffs, templates used and intent gates. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_crm_funnel_report
tools.title: Show the CRM lead funnel
tools.description: Enquiries routed to a showroom, qualified leads and Zoho deals created for a date range, by vertical and enquiry category. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_google_reviews_report
tools.title: Show the Google reviews report
tools.description: Google reviews for a date range: rating spread, automatic versus manual replies, and by store location. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_live_conversation_metrics
tools.title: Show live conversation metrics
tools.description: Right now: open, unattended, unassigned and pending conversations, optionally for one team. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_live_metrics_by_group
tools.title: Show live metrics by agent or team
tools.description: Right now, per agent, team or inbox: open, unattended and unassigned conversations. Needs report access.

tools.name: list_csat_responses
tools.title: List CSAT responses
tools.description: Customer satisfaction ratings and feedback by conversation, agent and inbox for a date range, 25 per page. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_csat_metrics
tools.title: Show CSAT totals
tools.description: For a date range: surveys sent, responses, response rate and how the ratings spread. Needs report access.

tools.name: list_applied_slas
tools.title: List SLA results
tools.description: Conversations with an SLA applied and whether each met or missed it, for a date range. Administrators only.

tools.name: get_sla_metrics
tools.title: Show SLA totals
tools.description: How many conversations met or missed their SLA, and the hit rate, for a date range. Administrators only.

tools.name: list_reporting_events
tools.title: List reporting events
tools.description: The account's reporting events (first responses, resolutions, reopenings) with their times, for a date range. Administrators only.

tools.name: get_follow_up_report
tools.title: Show the follow-ups report
tools.description: Open and in-range conversation counts for each follow-up label the administrators chose. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_forwarded_email_report
tools.title: Show the forwarded emails report
tools.description: The weekly Forwarded Emails report for one email category: each customer email first forwarded to a team that week, who got it and what came of it. Needs report access.

args.name: week
args.description: Any day of the week (India time); last week unless given.

tools.name: list_forwarded_email_categories
tools.title: List forwarded email categories
tools.description: The email categories the Forwarded Emails report covers, from the bridge's routing rules. Needs report access.

tools.name: get_my_year_in_review
tools.title: Show my year in review
tools.description: The person's Year in Review for one year: conversations handled, busiest times and highlights.
